home.second_section_first_text: O Pioneiro do Mondego is a family-run adventure sports and ecotourism company based in the municipality of Penacova. Our main activity is organizing river descents by kayak and canoe on the Mondego river, between Penacova and Coimbra - a canoeing trip through the Mondego valley, which we have been organizing daily since 1988! O Pioneiro was founded in 1988 by two Belgian teachers, Dirk and Kristien, and was one of the first companies in Portugal's tourism sector specialized in adventure sports, and the country's first canoeing company. Over the years, the company has grown and more than 100,000 people from around the world have done the Mondego kayak descent with us. Today, the Pioneiro do Mondego descent is a national and international reference point, having been named by the American guide Rough Guides as a reference for Coimbra tourism - alongside the University - and as one of the top 15 places to visit in Portugal.
home.second_section_second_text: Portugal's most popular and fantastic route. We organize daily descents of 18 or 25 km. Easy, incredible views, excellent equipment!

routes.first_section_text:
The combination of the natural beauty of the Mondego valley - with its rocks, forests and river beaches - with an excellent and stable water flow has made the Mondego the preferred river for canoeing at a national level. Enjoy a relaxing and refreshing day, and observe the majestic kites, kingfishers and a wide variety of fish.

We offer two route options:
routes.routeOne_section_text:
The route for everyone! With a length of 18 km, it starts at the Carvoeira weir; 500 m below the Penacova river beach and ends at Torres do Mondego, 3 km below the Casal da Misarela river beach. The entire route passes through the natural Mondego valley - in the middle of the forest - passing the small mountain villages of Ronqueira, Rebordosa, Louredo, Foz do Caneiro and Casal. This part of the river is full of small beaches on the banks, perfect for taking a break for a picnic or a swim. At the river beach bar you also have the possibility to stop for a small snack, a beer or an ice cream. This part of the river usually has a slight current, which makes this route easy; accessible to all ages.

The route takes about 3-4 hours by kayak. We usually meet at 10:00 at Torres do Mondego - or at 10:30 in Penacova. For those without transport, we can pick you up in Coimbra city center. In Penacova, equipment is distributed and instructions are given. The departure of the canoes is usually around 11:00. The expected arrival at Torres is between 15:00 and 17:00.
routes.image_Description_routeOne: Image of the 18 km route from Penacova to Torres do Mondego
routes.image_Description_routeTwo: Image of the 25 km route from Penacova to Coimbra
routes.routeTwo_section_text:
The classic route! The full 25 km route; in addition to the initial 18 km, this route includes the last 7 km to Coimbra center. This route is made more difficult by the widening of the river bed and absence of current in the last kilometers; in addition, there is usually the mythical headwind that can produce a slight swell. But those who endure this distance have the privilege of entering Coimbra by water, seeing the tower of the University of Coimbra from afar. This descent is recommended for more athletic people who see the descent not only as an activity to relax, but also as a physical challenge.

The route takes about 4-5 hours by kayak. We usually meet at 10:00 at the Parque Verde nautical club in Coimbra - or at 10:30 in Penacova. In Penacova, equipment is distributed and instructions are given. The departure of the canoes is usually around 11:00. The expected arrival in Coimbra is between 16:30 and 18:00.
routes.night_section_text: Once a month we usually organize a night descent for those who have some experience in kayaking and want to experience our valley in a different way; illuminated by the full moon. Contact us to find out when the next one will be!
routes.meeting_point_section_text: We offer three convenient meeting points:
routes.pointOne_text:
Start of the routes

Meeting at 10:30

At our embarkation pier, next to the Carvoeira weir, on the left bank.

Directions from IP3 - Coimbra-Viseu:

-IP3 - Exit at the second Penacova exit
-Follow towards the Mondego river (do not go up to the village of Penacova)
-Cross the bridge over the Mondego and turn right
-Pass the village of 'Carvoeira'
-Continue to the junction with the sign 'Travasso'
-Turn right and reaching the river, turn right again
-Follow for 200m to the weir.
routes.image_Description_meetingPointOne: Image of the meeting point in Penacova
routes.pointTwo_text:
Arrival of the 18km route

Meeting at 9:45 - Transport at 10:00

At our private and fenced parking lot on the river bank, which is at the entrance to Torres do Mondego. The location is on the old road from Coimbra to Penacova (N110).

It is possible to camp and barbecue in this park, check
here!


Directions from Lisbon or Porto:
-Exit at Coimbra-Sul
-Follow Coimbra-Centro (Lisboa N1)
-Cross Ponte Rainha Sta. Isabel
-Follow "estrada da beira" N17
-Before the Pontes da Portel bridges over the Mondego, turn left - N110
-Follow 1km on the N110 towards Penacova.
-Meeting place at the Gate that gives entrance to the path to the parking lot by the river in Torres do Mondego.
routes.image_Description_meetingPointTwo: Image of the meeting point in Torres do Mondego
routes.pointThree_text:
Arrival of the 25km route

Meeting at 9:45
Next to the Coimbra nautical club and the "Pedro e Ines" pedestrian bridge, on the left bank of the river (opposite bank to the city of Coimbra). The location is also known as "Parque Verde" and "Choupalinho". There is a parking lot, and a public and free caravan park by the river where you can leave your cars.

Directions from Lisbon or Porto:

-Exit the A1 at Coimbra-Sul
-Follow Coimbra-Centro (Lisboa N1)
-At the "Portugal dos Pequenitos" roundabout turn right towards Ponte Rainha Sta. Isabel/N17
-At the next roundabout enter the last (3rd) turn and immediately turn left (direction parque verde/exploratorio)
-After the exploratorio, park next to the swimming pools.

items.question: What are the minimum requirements to do the descent?
items.answer: The descent is accessible to anyone with normal physical condition; however, as canoeing is a water sport, we ask that any participant knows how to swim. All participants wear life vests and are covered by personal accident and public liability insurance provided by the company. Swimming competence is necessary for participants to feel comfortable and not panic in case of falling into the water.

items.question: Why choose O Pioneiro?
items.answer: The great popularity of the descents has opened the market to some competing companies. Nevertheless, we believe that as 'Pioneers', with almost 30 years of experience, we can offer considerable advantages. Not only are we the only company that does the descent every day; we also have the largest fleet of canoes on the river, thus being able to accept any number of people; from individual participants to groups of hundreds of people. We also have an unmatched variety of equipment choices: double and single kayaks, from the more classic and stable sit-inside types to the latest sit-on-top river kayaks. Our team is made up of young local guides with years of experience who know the river like no one else and speak multiple languages. We have the most flexible booking system on the market, making it easier to organize your group. We have private facilities and parking lots, avoiding the confusion of summer weekends. Finally, our monitoring and safety system prioritizes our customers' freedom; so everyone can make the descent at their own pace, without being forced to stay in a group tour. All this at competitive prices!

items.question: How far in advance can we make a reservation?
items.answer: During quiet periods, and for small groups, you can still make a reservation one day before the date. But to be sure of sufficient availability, it is always advisable to book as early as possible (especially for large groups and during weekends).

items.question: How do we make a reservation?
items.answer: Reservations can be made by phone, email or through this website. We need the name of the group leader, the phone number and the number of people intended. We ask you to confirm the reservation with the exact number of people one week before the descent date.

items.question: How is payment processed?
items.answer: Payment can be made on the day itself; in cash or by check - or by bank transfer, sending us proof of transfer before the descent date. O Pioneiro do Mondego's NIB is 0035 0594 0001 3345 1304 5 - NIF: 502 042 133.

items.question: What should we bring?
items.answer:
Don't forget:
-Dry clothes for the end of the descent
-Footwear that can get wet (preferably sneakers)
-1 ID document from the group leader
-Water and something to eat (there's a bar halfway through)
-Sun protection!
-Masks to wear during transport.

items.question: What about lunch?
items.answer:
Traditionally people bring a picnic that they can eat on the numerous beaches along the route. You can also eat something at the river beach, where the bar serves toasted sandwiches, sandwiches and pork sandwiches.
We can also organize a snack or barbecue for groups during the descent; inquire by email. At the end we have barbecue grills that can be used for a low extra cost.

items.question: Can children go down the river?
items.answer: Children of any age can descend the Mondego by canoe, as long as they feel comfortable in the water and are accompanied by an adult who takes responsibility for the child. We have life jackets for everyone, even for the smallest ones from 15 kilos. We have special little seats to place in the middle between the parents in a double boat. We have special prices for children and young people. Keep in mind the sun exposure, however.

items.question: Do you need all the participants' names?
items.answer: No. Some adventure sports companies require all participants' names for insurance purposes. To make things much less complicated and flexible for organizing groups, we opted for an insurance company that does not require this data; take advantage!

items.question: How does your monitoring policy work?
items.answer: O Pioneiro do Mondego tries to find a balance between the safety and freedom of its participants. We want to do everything to give you the maximum security you desire, while not wanting to give the feeling of a school trip where everyone has to stay in the group. Therefore, we guarantee permanent monitoring in the most complicated places, while giving you the freedom to follow at your own pace without accompaniment. There will always be monitors behind the group, and those who do not feel safe or want more security can always stay with them. Those who wish can also always book personal monitoring.
